visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a festive restaurant setting with warm, dim lighting and red-paneled walls decorated for Christmas. A female server, dressed in a voluminous green Christmas tree costume with a massive yellow star headpiece, approaches a table where a male and a female customer are seated. The server holds a small serving tray and prepares to interact with the guests. (2) As the server leans over to place a dish on the table, her oversized star headpiece physically strikes the female customer on the forehead. The server continues to move, causing the star to bump into a menu and other tabletop items. Her facial expressions shift from a professional smile to a sheepish, apologetic look as she uses her hands to attempt to steady the bulky headpiece. (3) A male server wearing a brown reindeer costume with large plush antlers enters the frame to assist. The servers' headpieces—the star and the antlers—clumsily collide and push against each other as they both try to bend down to pick up a dropped item. The physical struggle is evident in their strained body movements and shifting postures while the customers watch with amused and confused expressions. (4) The scene transitions to a photo-taking moment. The two servers and the two customers cluster together closely in front of the camera. The reindeer server extends his arm as if holding a phone for a selfie. They all smile broadly and pose with peace signs. The background remains the consistent cozy restaurant interior with Christmas garlands and ornaments visible.
